title: pyrus albopilosa
intro: Pyrus albopilosa, commonly known as the white-haired pear, is a species of plant in the family Rosaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus albopilosa include its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and other respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Pyrus albopilosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
